patronOf.en-US: Bishop and Doctor of the Church

prayerExcerpt.en-US: May your Church be aided by his intercession, just as she has been instructed by his heavenly teaching.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Que sua intercessão ajude a vossa Igreja, que ele instruiu com ensinamentos celestiais.

meta.face: A venerable Hispano-Roman of about seventy with a LARGE, HEAVY, LONG face — a broad, high forehead, a large, strong nose with a gentle hook and a fleshy tip, heavy-lidded dark eyes lowered to the page under thick grey brows, full cheeks, and a broad chin under a full, thick grey beard of medium length, trimmed round and still dark at the moustache; thick grey hair cut short around a tonsure; a calm, absorbed, scholarly look.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; Murillo's painting (Wikipedia lead) shows the aged archbishop reading, with a grey beard. The card keeps the old scholar-bishop and his grey beard, gives him a heavy, long face of our choice, and dresses him as a bishop of his own century rather than in Murillo's mitre.
